Container.Name: MonarchAegis
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, containerized P2P file replication over SSH/rsync (plus an integrity-checked tar-stream transport) with a web control plane. MonarchAegis keeps an authoritative SQLite catalog of file fingerprints for fast diffs and confines every transfer to a directory-scoped, write-only SSH jail.
Container.Description: MonarchAegis is a fast, specialized P2P synchronizer designed for environments where traditional indexing is too slow. It relies on a Source container and a Client container pairing natively over SSH/rsync using auto-generated directory-scoped SSH keys.

Config.Name: WebGUI Port
Config.Description: The port used to access the MonarchAegis web interface. Container Port: 5000

Config.Name: P2P SSH Port
Config.Description: The port used by rsync to transfer files securely between Source and Client. Container Port: 2222

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Container Path: /config. Stores database, lua configurations, and SSH keys.

Config.Name: AppData Logs Path
Config.Description: Container Path: /logs. Stores the live rsync, daemon, and UI tracking logs.

Config.Name: Source/Destination Data Path
Config.Description: Container Path: /source_data. The actual filesystem location containing the files you want to sync or receive.

Config.Name: Initial Role
Config.Description: Container Variable: MONARCHAEGIS_ROLE. Sets the STARTING role on first launch only — 'source' (sender) or 'client' (receiver). After that the role is stored in the database and changed from the role dropdown in the web UI; editing this variable later has no effect.

Config.Name: Internal SSH Port
Config.Description: Container Variable: MONARCHAEGIS_SSH_PORT. Internal port for the SSH daemon. Must match the target of your P2P SSH Port mapping.

Config.Name: Hash Workers
Config.Description: Container Variable: MONARCHAEGIS_HASH_WORKERS. Number of parallel threads for baseline file hashing. Defaults to half of CPU cores (max 16). Increase for faster scans on high-core-count CPUs.
